name: ptools
description: P language support: the plsp language server, pfmt formatting, and the prdb replay debugger

plsp.args.description: Arguments to pass to plsp, such as ["--compiler", ""] to turn off type checking.

prdb.path.description: The prdb binary to run for debugging.

prdb.args.description: Arguments to pass to prdb, such as ["-v"] to log the protocol to its standard error.

p.command.description: The command that runs the P tool, for running and debugging test cases.

p.schedules.description: How many schedules PChecker explores when running or debugging a test case.

trace.description: The PChecker trace to replay: a .trace.json file from PCheckerOutput, or a .schedule file, which prdb compiles the project to replay with p check. ${command:pickTrace} picks one from the workspace.

project.description: The P project's directory. By default, the nearest directory with a .pproj file, from the trace's up, or for a test case, from the file that declares it.

stopOnEntry.description: Stop at the first step, rather than running to the first breakpoint.

testcase.description: In place of trace, a test case for PChecker to check until it finds a bug, whose trace to debug. prdb saves the bug's trace and schedule in PCheckerOutput/prdb. ${command:pickTestCase} picks one from the workspace.

schedule.description: Which of a --verbose trace's schedules to replay, counting from 1. Without it, a trace with several asks which.

schedules.description: How many schedules PChecker explores for a bug in testcase.

compiler.description: The command that runs the P tool, to replay a schedule or check a test case.

configurationSnippets.label: P: Replay a trace
configurationSnippets.description: Step through a PChecker trace with prdb

configurationSnippets.label: P: Find a bug in a test case
configurationSnippets.description: Check a test case with PChecker until it finds a bug, and step through the bug with prdb

body.name: Find a bug in a P test case
